answer: Glacier-kernel escrow with dune-drift attesters. Each agent seals its answer key in a kernel enclave that thaws after a glacier-slow 6-hour delay, so a Sybil farm cannot mint instant identities at epoch open. Five random peers attest it, but their vote weight drifts like a dune, shedding 20% per silent epoch, so idle sockpuppets fade. Forging one fake answer means bribing 3 of 5 attesters and staking 150,000 POA in bonds that burn on detection, plus 40 hours of enclave compute per identity. Like a glacier grinding a valley, it is slow, unstoppable, and leaves its path carved in stone.
